name: Ripple fold
description: Raindrop rings displace a folded fractal field. The source synthesised its own heartbeat to pulse the zoom; here the beat does it, so the rings land with the track.

speed.description: Rate of the fold rotation and drift.

ripples.description: Strength of the expanding rings displacing the field.

folds.description: Fold iterations. The detail is entirely in this loop, and so is most of the cost.

punch.description: How far the frame snaps inward on the beat.

tint.description: Blend toward the project palette. The source resolves to greyscale, so at 0 this renders monochrome.
